capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 78.1 kWh nominal, LG 5L NMC (EV Database); Wikipedia lists 78.1 kWh for Premium RWD/AWD. EV Database Premium AWD (Highland, Dec 2025+): 82.0 kWh nominal / 79.0 kWh usable, LG 5M NMC, 250 kW, 11 kW AC; the existing OpenEV data for the 2026 Canadian Premium AWD-I is the same 82/79. Same trim line carried to the 2027 US car; KBB US 2026 lists 75 kWh for Premium without saying usable or gross, so a US 78.1/75 pack is possible.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2027 Premium AWD). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.
